item.title: Upper-Limb D1 Flexion Pattern
clinicalUse: Neurological and orthopedic rehabilitation for coordinated reach/hand-to-mouth type pattern
patientPosition: Supine or sitting depending on control.
therapistPosition: Beside affected arm, facing movement direction.
stabilization: Trunk supported; allow scapular motion when appropriate.
contact: One hand guides hand/wrist; other guides forearm/upper arm with lumbrical grip.
forceDirection: Resistance opposite the diagonal while allowing smooth motion into flexion-adduction-external rotation pattern.
item.visualCue: Diagonal from low/outside → up/across toward face; smooth resisted pattern.

subTechniques.name: Upper-Limb D1 Pattern
subTechniques.clinicalGoal: Improve coordinated reach and functional upper-limb movement
subTechniques.patientSetup: Supine, side-lying or sitting with the arm supported.
subTechniques.contact: Region-specific contact over Shoulder–elbow–wrist diagonal using the parent technique principles.
subTechniques.direction: Diagonal/spiral D1 flexion-extension pattern with graded resistance
subTechniques.dosage: Use a conservative response-guided trial and reassess before repeating.
